String.string:
[EN] You set off a trap!
[ES] ¡Activaste una trampa!

[EN] Something falls from above.
[ES] Algo cae desde arriba.

[EN] You disarmed the trap.
[ES] Desactivaste la trampa.

[EN] The chamber door opens.
[ES] La puerta de la cámara se abre.

[EN] Entered Kelsaik's Hall.
[ES] Entraste al Salón de Kelsaik.

[EN] The chamber door closes.
[ES] La puerta de la cámara se cierra.

[EN] Do not fear death; no crystals will be destroyed.
[ES] No temas a la muerte; no se destruirán Crystal.

[EN] Resurrect your allies and keep trying.
[ES] Resucita a tus aliados y sigue intentándolo.

[EN] United we're stronger.
[ES] Unidos somos más fuertes.

[EN] Don't mix fire and ice.
[ES] No mezcles fuego y hielo.

[EN] One tank can't do this alone. It's time to tag.
[ES] Un tanque no puede hacer esto solo. Es hora de alternar.

[EN] If it's fire, hide behind your tank. Staying alive is your priority.
[ES] Si es fuego, escóndete detrás de tu tanque. Mantenerse con vida es tu prioridad.

[EN] If it jumps, you should jump too.
[ES] Si salta, tú también deberías saltar.

[EN] Don't focus on the slaves.
[ES] No te centres en los esclavos.

[EN] You must know you won't escape.
[ES] Debes saber que no escaparás.
